scope: Update tray and calendar contrast from the active Plasma Activity on each monitor.

checks.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_wallpaper_activity.py in the primary Arch SDK (Plasma 6.8.3), private Wayland session, two outputs and two Activities
python -m pytest -q tests/test_release_update.py and paired release preflight against the downloaded Tahoe commit archive

coverage_limits: The approved preview shows one of two virtual outputs in a KDE neon guest running Plasma 6.8.1 on Wayland. The first and return frames matched byte for byte. Physical monitors and a separate Golden Gate desktop were not exercised.
